_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, in which voice, on which engine, at what prosody — so a later edit to any of those can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

open.text: Your Home Assistant Voice PE, answered by a Companion that runs on your hardware.

local.text: Say the wake word and the answer comes from a local model, grounded in your Companion Memory, with every word staying in your home.

fits.text: It plugs into Home Assistant Assist through the standard Wyoming integration, and needs no custom component.

yours.text: Answers come from Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible model. Speech can stay with Home Assistant's own Whisper and Piper. Memory is optional.

close.text: Give your Voice PE a memory with Companion Voice. Visit h a dot ci dot computer. UnCloud your life.
